# Mahmoud Abdelnaby

> Bilingual professional portfolio and growing public library of reusable assistant prompts across marketing, research, writing, creative work, technology, and business. The site publishes prompt text and guidance; it does not host or run AI models.

## Portfolio
- [English portfolio](https://mahmoudabdelnaby1.github.io/)
- [الملف المهني بالعربية](https://mahmoudabdelnaby1.github.io/ar/)

## Marketing systems playbooks
- [English playbooks guide](https://mahmoudabdelnaby1.github.io/playbooks/): descriptions, inputs, workflow boundaries, and usage guidance for six practical toolkits.
- [دليل الأدلة العملية بالعربية](https://mahmoudabdelnaby1.github.io/ar/playbooks/): شرح الاستخدام والمدخلات وما تتضمنه الأدلة الستة وحدود كل منها.
- [Open playbook source files on GitHub](https://github.com/mahmoudabdelnaby1/marketing-systems-playbooks)

## Assistant library
- [Browse the English assistant library](https://mahmoudabdelnaby1.github.io/#assistant-library)
- [تصفح مكتبة المساعدين بالعربية](https://mahmoudabdelnaby1.github.io/ar/#assistant-library)
- [Complete crawlable page index](https://mahmoudabdelnaby1.github.io/sitemap.xml)

## Page format
Each assistant page explains its purpose, expected inputs and outputs, how to use the prompt with a general chat model, a task example, the full reusable prompt, and related assistants. Original prompt text is in English; explanatory pages are available in English and Arabic.
